'''R2-A3''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] used aboard [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]' [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] during his time stationed at the [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]],<ref name="RebelScum" /> and aboard the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']].<ref name="SW6" />

==Biography==
Approximately [[0 ABY/Legends|two months after the Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="SW1">[[Star Wars (2013) 1|''Star Wars'' (2013) 1]]</ref> R2-A3 joined [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] in his [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] during a demonstration exercise for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Stealth Squadron|Gray Flight]], locking the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot's]] [[S-foils/Legends|S-foils]] into attack position, and confirming that the craft's weapons were in training mode.<ref name="SW3">[[Star Wars (2013) 3|''Star Wars'' (2013) 3]]</ref>

Later, R2-A3 accompanied Antilles<ref name="SW5" /> on a covert scouting mission to [[Pybus]],<ref name="SW4">[[Star Wars (2013) 4|''Star Wars'' (2013) 4]]</ref> during which Gray Flight was [[Ambush of Gray Flight|ambushed]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces led by [[Kell Bircher]].<ref name="SW5" /> [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was rendered unconcious in the engagement, leading Antilles to command R2-A3 to link with Organa's [[R2-T4|onboard astromech droid]], [[Slave circuit|slaving]] her [[Navigation computer/Legends|nav computer]] to his own as he made the jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="SW6" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although Wedge Antilles can be seen flying with partially visible red- and white-domed astromech droids in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], neither droid matches R2-A3, despite the droid being designed by [[Hasbro]] from film reference images.<ref name="Hasbro1">{{WebCite|url=http://www.toymania.com/news/messages/11570.shtml|text="October 2009 Hasbro Star Wars Q&A"|work=Raving Toy Maniac, ToyMania.com|archivedate=20091010193233}}</ref> The astromech appeared, unnamed, as an action figure packed with Wedge Antilles' X-wing [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in [[2009]]. The name R2-A3 was revealed by Hasbro after learning it from [[Lucasfilm]] in [[2010]].<ref name="Hasbro2">{{WebCite|url=http://www.toymania.com/news/messages/11894.shtml|text="February 2010 Hasbro Star Wars Q&A (Part Two)"|work=Raving Toy Maniac, ToyMania.com|archivedate=20100226112136}}</ref>
